title: NWSL Soccer
description:

Gotham FC hosts Seattle Reign FC in an NWSL quarterfinal game at Sports Illustrated Stadium. Gotham has won three of the last five meetings, including a 3-2 victory in July, while Seattle looks to earn its first win over Gotham this season.

title: NWSL Soccer
description:
